summary: Multi-fold evaluation of h=90 candidates using raw-unit LightGBM and Ridge, non-COVID fold-3 train rows, evaluated on non-zero val rows per fold. Fold-1 and fold-2 provide ~68 and ~67 h=90 val rows respectively, making the estimate much more reliable than fold-3 alone (5 rows). Feature set A excludes all anchor_correct columns. Identified that lgbm_A_no_anc (no anchor feature) is the strongest candidate across folds.

findings.note: Results are approximate summaries. Exact per-fold MAEs available from state/current.json champions.h90 after iteration_016 refit.

handoff.read_this_first: Multi-fold h=90 evaluation confirmed lgbm_A_no_anc (no anchor feature) as best candidate. Iteration 016 selects and saves the fold-3 champion config.

durable_rules.rule: Use feature set A (no anchor_correct_h90) for h=90 ML model. Adding anchor_correct_h90 as a feature does not help and may hurt.
durable_rules.why: anchor_correct_h90 is corrupted by COVID rows in its lookback window for the validation period.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Corrupted anchor feature adds noise to predictions for h=90.

content_carried_forward.h90_feature_set: feat_A: all numeric columns except bread_quantity, date, _split, _fold_*, bread_quantity_h*, ratio_h*, ratio_correct_h*, anchor_correct_h*, anchor_h*
